metadata.spec: W3C DOM Level 4 & Shadow DOM v1 Specification
metadata.boundary: Element.attachShadow({ mode: "closed" }) forces element.shadowRoot to strictly evaluate to null outside the constructor closure. Browser C++ DOM bindings (V8/Blink, WebKit) enforce encapsulation so no standard webpage runtime JavaScript can pierce a closed root.
